scenario.summary: Adversaries target SMBs as a pathway into larger supply chains, using phishing and exploitation of public-facing applications for initial access. Post-compromise, they utilize 'living off the land' techniques and unsanctioned remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools to steal credentials and deploy ransomware.

meta.rationale: Focus on workstations and file servers. Workstations are the primary beachhead for LOLBAS and infostealers, while file servers provide visibility into mass encryption impact.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is using signed system binaries to proxy execution of infostealers or ransomware, transitioning from stealthy credential harvesting to mass file encryption.

hunt.name: Post-Compromise Evasion and Ransomware Impact
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the progression from defense evasion to destructive impact. It begins by identifying LOLBAS binaries performing suspicious network requests. The hunt then fans out to investigate whether these specific hosts show signs of credential theft or high-velocity file encryption. By scoping the impact queries to the suspicious hosts identified in the lead, the hunt distinguishes malicious activity from fleet-wide background noise and administrative maintenance.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{lolbas_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_path) || ',') > 0 AND (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%http%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%ftp%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find instances of signed Microsoft binaries being used to execute code or fetch content, which often precedes credential theft or ransomware deployment.
config.expected_signal: Trusted binaries behaving as downloaders. Silence suggests no obvious LOLBAS abuse in this window.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_name, file_path, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id IN (2, 14) AND instr(',' || '{{credential_filenames}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify processes reading browser password and session stores, limited to suspicious hosts to ensure findings are actionable.
config.expected_signal: Anomalous processes accessing sensitive credential files. Silence suggests no secondary file impact on those machines.

nodes.label: Mass File Activity and Ransom Notes

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT file_path) AS file_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) OR instr(',' || '{{ransom_note_filenames}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING file_count > 500 OR MAX(CASE WHEN instr(',' || '{{ransom_note_filenames}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
config.description: Find high-velocity file modifications or ransom note creation scoped to the suspicious hosts.
config.expected_signal: A process touching many unique files or dropping a ransom note. Silence indicates no active mass encryption.

primitive_config.label: Mass File Activity and Ransom Notes
